description.value: The level of technology achieved in the Pact Worlds today wouldn't be possible without the army of advanced engineering bots that maintain the industrial infrastructure of every city, satellite, and space station. You were one of these bots, tasked with repairing hardware or debugging software so that people could live in comfort. You become trained in one of the following skills: Computers or Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in both of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. If you selected Computers, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Phreaker] skill feat. If you selected Crafting, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Quick Repair] skill feat.
